content: Yakop iyub palotiiŋ to ŋgeu aidaba
Olman Isak inim olman waat wa. Ve mata ipis, le irau ighita ndug muul maau. Sawa eez, ye ipoi natu olman Esau ighaze: “Natug!” Esau iyok pa aliŋa ighaze: “Taug nene. Sa?”
Ghoro olman Isak isaav pani ighaze: “Ulooŋ. You nanim olman waat wa, ve nakankaan pa mateeŋ tiou.
Tovenen ugham pane tiom, ve ula pa su, ve ukaal ag aniiŋ ziga.
Leso ugharaat ag sur to you lolog pani ne, ve ughami inim naghun. Ghoro naghur poia to Maaron iza tiom. Ve muri ighaze namaat, namaat lak.”

Isak yesuru natu Esau tisavsaav, ve olman tidi Rebeka taliŋa irab saveeŋ todi. Tovenen Esau ila pa su ve ikaal aniiŋ ziga, ve Rebeka isaav pa natu Yakop ighaze: “Ŋgaramus nalooŋ tamam isaav pa togham ighaze:
‘Esau, ugham aniiŋ ziga eta to su inim ve ugharaat ag sur to you lolog pani ne, ve ughami inim naghun. Ghoro naghur palotiiŋ tiou iza tiom ila Maaron mata. Ve muri ighaze namaat, namaat lak.’
Tovenen natug, ulooŋ aliŋag, ve utaghon saveeŋ tiou tonene.
Ula ndug to ŋgai toit tinepneep pani, ve ughita mekmek papaghu ruta to tubudi, ghoro ugham di tinim. You pale nagharaat tamam a sur poia to ye lolo pani kat.
Leso ughami ila pani ve ighun. Ve ighur poia to Maaron iza tiom le isob, ghoro imaat.”
Eemoghon Yakop ipamuul tina aliŋa ighaze: “Tinaŋ, aliŋam poia. Eemoghon toghag Esau, ye tini ororoma. Ve you maau.
Ighaze tamaŋ ikis ghou ris, nene pale ighilaal ghou, ve igham ŋgar ighaze you nagham mogheraaŋ pani. Ghoro ighur poia to Maaron iza tiou maau, ve ighur samia iza tiou.”
Eemoghon tina isaav pani ighaze: “Natug, ugham ŋgar naol malep. Ulooŋ aliŋag tonene, ve utaghoni. Ighaze ye ighur samia iza tiom, nene pale you nambaad pataŋani tonenen. Ula ugham mekmek tinim.”
Tovenen Yakop imundig, ve ila igham mekmek ru tinim to tina. Rebeka nima rikrikia pa gharatooŋ sur poia to Isak lolo pani.
Le isob, ve ila igham nonogiiŋa poia kat to natu olman Esau to ineep mbeez toni lolo, ve ighami ila to Yakop, leso indudi pani.
Ghoro ikau mekmek uli ila Yakop lua ve ila nima paam.
Ve igham sur toman mberet to ye igharaata, ve ighuri ila to Yakop.
Yakop ila to tama, ve ipoii ighaze: “Tamaŋ, nanim wa!” Tama Isak ighaze: “Natug, taug nene. Ve yom sei?”
Yakop isaav pani muul ighaze: “You Esau, natum aidaba. Sur toman aniiŋ ziga to yom usaav payou pani, tauto naghami nanim. Umundig ve ughun, ve ughur poia to Maaron iza tiou.”
Isak ilooŋ saveeŋ tonene, ve ighasoni ighaze: “Wai, natug, vena to yom undeeŋ mbeb rikia moghon?” Yakop ipamuul aliŋa ighaze: “Maaron tiom Yoova iuul ghou. Tauto rikia moghon ve nandeeŋa.”
Ghoro Isak isaav pani muul ighaze: “Natug, unum ugharau ghou, ve nakis tinim ve nayamaana. Leso nawatag kat: Yom natug Esau, ma maau?”
Tovenen Yakop ila igharaui, ve tama ikis tini ve iyamaana, ghoro isaav pani ighaze: “Aliŋam inimale Yakop aliŋa. Eemoghon nimam inimale Esau nima.”

Isak ighilaal Yakop maau. Pasa, nima ororoma inimale togha Esau. Tovenen Isak ighaze ighur poia to Maaron iza toni. Eemoghon lolo ru sone. Tovenen ighasoni muul ighaze: “Onoon, natug Esau taum tonene?” Yakop ipamuul aliŋa ighaze: “Vee, you taug tonene.”

Tovenen Isak isaav pani ighaze: “Natug, ugham sur tonanan inim. Lolog pa naghun sur to yom ugharaata toman ziga to su. Naghun le isob, ghoro naghur poia to Maaron iza tiom.” Tovenen Yakop igham sur ila to tama Isak ve ighun. Ve igham a ya vaen paam ila ighun.
Tama Isak ighun le isob, ve isaav pani ighaze: “Natug, unum usavag ghou.”
Tovenen Yakop ila isavag tama. Isak iyaaz Esau vuzi to ineep ila nonogiiŋa toni, ve ighur poia to Maaron iza to Yakop ighaze: Hib 11:20

content.text: “Aa, natug tonene, vuzi inimale su to poia to Maaron ineep pani!
Maaron pale igham waam tiina to sambam izi payom, ve ipambees taan tiom. Leso ŋgoreeŋa tiina, ve aniiŋ ve vaen katindi tivot payom.
Ve taan pida tamtoghona pale tiput aghedi payom ve tipakur ghom.
Yom pale unum tiina pa toŋvetaz tiom, ve tinam ndinatu tiput aghedi payom.
Tamtoghon tisob to tighur samia iza tiom, nene pale taudi tindeeŋ pataŋani.
Ve yes to tighason Maaron pa ighur poia toni iza tiom, nene pale poia toni iza todi paam.” Mbnp 25:23

content: Esau itaŋ roran tama ighaze ipaloti paam
Isak ighur poia to Maaron iza to Yakop le isob, ghoro Yakop ipuli, ve ivot ila. Mala maau ve togha Esau ineep su ve ivot.
Ye paam igharaat sur poia kat, ve ighami ila to tama, ve isaav pani ighaze: “Tamaŋ, you nagharaat sur tiom toman ziga to su, tauto naghami nanim! Umundig ve ughun, ve ughur poia to Maaron iza tiou.”
Isak ilooŋ saveeŋ toni, ve ighasoni ighaze: “Wai, yom sei paam?” Esau ipamuul aliŋa ighaze: “You Esau, natum aidaba.”

Isak ilooŋ saveeŋ tonene le tini irur kat, ve isaav pani ighaze: “Waii, yom unum sone, ve ŋgeu eez igham sur toman ziga to su inim ve naghun. Nene sei? You naghur poia to Maaron iza toni wa. Ve onoon kat, palotiiŋ tonowen pale ineep toni.”
Esau ilooŋ tama saveeŋ toni, le lolo isami pa tau, ve itaŋ tiina, ve itaŋ roran tama ighaze: “O tamaŋ, ughur poia to Maaron iza tiou paam!”
Eemoghon Isak isaav pani ighaze: “Wai, palotiiŋ to naghaze nagham payom, tauto tazim inim itombaan ghou, ve ighami ila wa!”
Tovenen Esau isaav ighaze: “Oyais, ŋgeu tonowen, tiwaat iza Yakop le deŋia kat pani!

Pasa, ye itombaan ghou pae ru wa! Muuŋ, itombaan ghou ve igham inag inim ŋgeu aidaba. Ve aazne, iyub palotiiŋ tiou paam.” Ghoro Esau ighason tama muul ighaze: “Tamaŋ, vena? Lem palotiiŋ eta payou maau?” Mbnp 25:29-34

Isak ipamuul aliŋa ighaze: “Wai, you naghur tazim inim tiina payom, ve naghur toŋvetaz tiam tisob tinim mbesooŋa pani wa. Ve naghason Maaron pa igham aniiŋ ve vaen anoŋadi katindi tivot pani, leso ineep pooi. Tovenen natug, mbeb eta ineep muul pa nagham payom maau.”

Eemoghon Esau itaŋ roran tama muul ighaze: “Tamaŋ vena? Palotiiŋ tiom ee moghon kat tonowen? Ite paam maau? O tamaŋ, ughur poia to Maaron iza tiou paam!” Ghoro Esau itaŋ muul toman aliŋa tiina. Hib 12:17
Tama Isak ipamuul aliŋa ighaze:

content.text: “Ndug tiom to nepooŋ, pale ineep mala pa taan ŋgoreeŋa,
ve waam to sambam irau izi payom maau.
Yom pale uparab pa buza, ghoro uneep pooi.
Ve pale unum mbesooŋa pa tazim.
Eemoghon muri pale uzoor pooz toni,
ve irau iŋgin ghom muul maau.”

content: Rebeka ikaal ataam to ipaghau Yakop pa togha Esau

Esau ikis malmaliiŋ toni pa Yakop ariaŋa. Pasa palotiiŋ toni, tauto tama ighuri iza to Yakop wa. Tovenen igham ŋgar ila lolo ighaze: “Mala maau pale tamamai imaat. Moŋiiŋ toni ighaze isob, ghoro narab tazig Yakop imaat.”
Eemoghon titig Rebeka taliŋa pa ŋgar to Esau ighaze ighami. Tovenen ipoi Yakop inim, ve isaav pani ighaze: “Natug, ulooŋ. Togham Esau ighaze irab ghom umaat, ghoro lolo poia ve ate izi.
Tovenen ulooŋ aliŋag, ve umundig rikia moghon, ve ughau ula to livug Laban to ineep izi Aran we.
Ula uneep tomani le togham ate izi o.
Ighaze lolo iluum, ve lolo imaagh pa ŋgar to ugham pani, nene pale nambaaŋ ilat payom, ghoro umuul unum. Pasa, you namatughez: Pale yamru aparab ve amaat pa sawa ee moghon.”

Ghoro Rebeka isaav pa Isak: “Oyai, ndirawaad liva to Hita tidi ne, tinig imum padi kat. Lolog pa Yakop ivai liva eta to taan tonene inimale yes tonene malep. Ighaze ye igham tovene, poia pa namaat nala. Naneep pasa?”

footnotes.text: Pisis Yakop, pughu tovene: ‘Aghe gudu.’ Saveeŋ tonene, nene saveeŋ palelaaŋ paam. Iŋarua yes to tighamgham kaarom.
